name: Purple cliffbrake
desc: Purple cliffbrake (Pellaea atropurpurea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pellaea atropurpurea, commonly known as purple-stem cliffbrake or just purple cliffbrake, is a fern native to North and Central America. Brake is an old word for fern, related to the word bracken.
